I am an old man, and I have farmed this land my whole life. This small maize plot near the house is important for feeding my family, so I will put some DAP and urea on it like the extension people tell us, but only what I can afford from the cooperative. I keep cattle, so I carry manure from the kraal to this plot every year — it is free and the soil here is tired. I cannot irrigate, we wait for the belg and meher rains like always, and my sons and I will do most of the work ourselves; maybe I hire a few neighbors with oxen for ploughing and at harvest.
